steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1')

steps.name: pick-a-room
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const r = s.floorPlan.rooms.find(rm => rm.name.toLowerCase().includes('bed')) || s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; window.__roomId = r.id; window.__roomName = r.name; s.setPlanSelection({ type: 'room', id: r.id }); return r.id })()

steps.name: expand-panel
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Expand properties"]'); if (b) b.click(); return !!b })()

steps.name: open-room-type-select
steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Room type"]'); if (!t) throw new Error('Room type select not found'); t.click(); return true })()

steps.name: pick-master-bedroom
steps.eval: (() => { const opt = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]')].find(o => o.textContent.trim() === 'Master bedroom'); if (!opt) throw new Error('Master bedroom option not found'); opt.click(); return true })()

steps.name: assert-category-set
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const r = s.floorPlan.rooms.find(rm => rm.id === window.__roomId); if (r.category !== 'masterBedroom') throw new Error('expected masterBedroom, got ' + r.category); return r.category })()

steps.name: assert-category-survives-rename
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const r = s.floorPlan.rooms.find(rm => rm.id === window.__roomId); if (r.category !== 'masterBedroom') throw new Error('category lost on rename: ' + r.category); if (r.name !== "Ella's room") throw new Error('name not renamed'); return { name: r.name, category: r.category } })()

steps.name: reset-to-auto
steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Room type"]'); t.click(); return true })()

steps.name: pick-auto
steps.eval: (() => { const opt = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]')].find(o => o.textContent.trim().startsWith('Auto')); if (!opt) throw new Error('Auto option not found'); opt.click(); return true })()

steps.name: assert-category-cleared
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const r = s.floorPlan.rooms.find(rm => rm.id === window.__roomId); if (r.category !== undefined) throw new Error('expected category cleared, got ' + r.category); return true })()
